Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/ExtendedMessageFormatAgentTest.java` with 29 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering constructors (default/explicit/null locale, with/without registry), custom format resolution (name/style args, whitespace handling, unknown-name rejection, overriding built-in names), `toPattern()` round-tripping, quoted-literal handling, built-in choice sub-format passthrough, `equals`/`hashCode` semantics, the four disabled `setFormat*` mutators (`UnsupportedOperationException`), and malformed-pattern error cases (unterminated quote, unterminated format element, invalid argument index). All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
